# Ranking stability, input preservation, and independent nested results.
docs = [{\"id\": \"b\", \"score\": 3, \"payload\": {\"x\": [1]}}, {\"id\": \"a\", \"score\": 3, \"payload\": {\"x\": [2]}}, {\"id\": \"z\", \"score\": -10, \"payload\": {}}]

r[0][\"payload\"][\"x\"].append(9)
assert docs == before and rank_documents(docs, 0) == []

# Full-result cache, canonical filters, isolation, expiry boundary, and retry.
calls = []
owned = [{\"id\": \"2\", \"score\": 2, \"payload\": {\"v\": [2]}}, {\"id\": \"1\", \"score\": 1, \"payload\": {\"v\": [1]}}]
def source(tenant, query, revision):
    calls.append((tenant, query, revision))
    return owned
cache = RetrievalCache(source, ttl=4)
q1 = {\"text\": \"q\", \"filters\": {\"b\": \"2\", \"a\": \"1\"}}
assert len(cache.search(\"t\", q1, \"r\", 0, limit=1)) == 1
owned[0][\"payload\"][\"v\"].append(8)

cache.search(\"t\", q2, \"r\", 4, limit=2)

attempts = []
def flaky(tenant, query, revision):
    attempts.append(1)
    if len(attempts) == 1: raise RuntimeError(\"retry\")

retry_cache = RetrievalCache(flaky)
try: retry_cache.search(\"t\", {\"text\": \"q\", \"filters\": {}}, \"r\", 0)
